audience: bookkeepers and businesses that issue invoices, record payments and track expenses in Vporiadku

useCases.title: Find invoices and check the payments on each one
useCases.text: List invoices and other documents with filters. Open one invoice for its lines, VAT and amount due, then list its payments.

useCases.title: Draft an invoice for a client
useCases.text: Find the client and the bank account, then create an invoice draft with lines and VAT. The draft is not issued and not sent.

useCases.title: Issue a draft and e-mail it to the client
useCases.text: Issue a draft, which locks it and takes the next number. Sending it e-mails the client for real.

useCases.title: Record a bank payment on an invoice
useCases.text: Record a payment received for an invoice, or mark the whole open amount as paid on a date.

useCases.title: Check supplier payments due this week
useCases.text: List the supplier payments due up to a date, and the payment orders that batch them.
